theme: Myth-busting: common misconceptions about mutual funds, addressed simply
headline: Mutual Funds: Separating Myth from Reality
body: Mutual funds aren't gambling. They're professionally managed pools of investor money investing in diversified securities.
caption: Think mutual funds are risky bets? Think again. Professional fund managers research and diversify investments to manage risk. Education matters before investing. #MutualFunds #InvestingMyths #FinancialLiteracy #MFMyths #InvestSmart
